messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Auto-alert: sustained RPM spike on model family \"opal9b\" via hosted-api. RPM ~5x baseline, error_rate +2.1% (500s/429s increasing). Paging eng-oncall @Priya K
Priya K: I'm oncall — taking this. Watching metrics now. tell me if there's an active rollout?
Marcus J: No rollout in prod. Seen increased small-context churn from a few tenants. Suspect step function callers sending long streaming sessions.
Ben L: I can try an emergency softcap. Recommend temporary per-model RPM trim to 40 RPM, keep TPM at 6k. Also disable function-calling for that model to cut token churn :thinking_face:
Priya K: Agree. Marcus please confirm no customer rollout depends on funcall. If ok, Ben go ahead. Marcus?
Marcus J: Confirmed — non-critical for top impacted tenants. OK to disable funcall for opal9b temporarily.
Ben L: Running command now:
```bash
curl -X POST \"https://controlplane.redwood.internal/admin/quotas\" \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{"model_family":"opal9b","rpm":40,"tpm":6000,"reason":"live mitigation: RPM spike"}'
```
Ben L: and disabling function-calling flag:
```bash
curl -X PATCH \"https://controlplane.redwood.internal/models/opal9b/config\" \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{"features":{"function_calling":false},"note":"mitigation to reduce token churn"}'
```
IncidentBot: Action logged: quota_change by Ben L @5372110205; config_change by Ben L @5372110220
Priya K: Support, please warn customers about possible 429s for opal9b and suggest fallback to opal9b-quant or opal9b-lite.
Alice M: On it. Opening support incident and running tenant impact query. Top impacted tenants: acme-corp, pixelworks, echo-labs. Estimated percent of opal9b traffic from those tenants: 47%.
SupportBot: INC-2026-793 created; status: investigating; priority: P2; assignee: Alice M; link: https://support.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-793
Marcus J: I'm spinning up additional opal9b-quant capacity as a fallback (dedicated pool + route weight tweak). Will push 20% traffic to quant variant.
Ben L: Routing tweak command:
```json
POST /routing/weights
{"from":"opal9b","to":"opal9b-quant","weight":0.2,"reason":"fallback for RPM spike"}
```
Ben L: Applied at 5372110400
Priya K: Metrics check in 2m. If error rate drops and latency stabilizes, keep softcap for 30m and monitor. If not, we will further reduce RPM or widen fallback.
Marcus J: Watching logs — 429s trending down, 95p latency from 450ms -> 320ms. Good.
Alice M: Customer comms sent to impacted tenants. Also posted status update on status.redwood.ai
Priya K: Good. Documenting timeline in the incident ticket and will hand to next oncall in 25m. Ben, leave the quota change note with rollback ETA? 
Ben L: Set expiry on quota change to auto-revert in 30m unless extended. Command included expiry param.
Ben L: Auto-revert scheduled @5372112200
Priya K: Great. If anything spikes again, page the oncall rotation and escalate to SRE lead. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Marcus J: Leaving monitoring alarms scoped: error_rate/opal9b >1.5% alert.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-793 updated: mitigation applied, severity P2, owner: Priya K
Priya K: Handing off in 20m to Ben L (next oncall). I'm staying on until handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
Ben L: Ack, ready to take over at handoff.
